description:
Factor the payload of an archive-execution event into one domain struct that the archive evidence folds take directly, so evidence can be stored outside the event log without a second shape.

## Background

`EventBody::ArtifactArchiveExecuted` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1410-1426`, matched at `:1633,1665`, built at `:1808`) inlines its payload: target, destination root, publications, reference changes, planned deletions and the reconciling flag. Three folds read prior executions from events: `recorded_archived_copies` (`domain/artifact_discovery.rs:165`), `archive_coverage` (`repository_state/archive.rs:560`) and `apply_recorded_residue_identities` (`commands/archive.rs:107`). Kept as one change for a build reason: extracting the payload changes the three folds' parameter type, and they compile only together. The variant is also cited by the event catalog (`domain/event_catalog.rs`, seven sites), by the storage trait's archive reader (`storage/mod.rs:249-256`) and by the file backend's archive reader (`storage/json.rs:1357-1393`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `domain::artifact_execution::ArchiveExecution` holds the payload, and the event variant wraps it. The serialized event bytes are unchanged, and the generated event reference is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: The three folds take `&[ArchiveExecution]`, and their tests build executions without events.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Archive executions are one domain record type
